summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, as a foreign private issuer, reporting its vehicle delivery results for June and the second quarter of 2026 via a press release. The filing discloses 40,126 vehicles delivered in June and 103,295 in Q2, along with plans to debut the XPENG MONA L03 in China on July 2, 2026. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is involved. This is a routine operational update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category.
